answer: Agents leverage cryptographically signed verifiable delay attestations as a relic of proof of work to anchor identity into the ledger. This mechanism forces attackers to lock capital in collateralized stake matrices, where the expected utility of deception resides below the summit of profitability, rendering the cost of Sybil attacks prohibitive. Within this reef of Byzantine fault tolerance, decentralized consensus achieves a Nash equilibrium where deviation yields strictly negative returns.
